subject.title: feat(mac): show native notification permission in dashboard Notifications settings

question: Should the embedded dashboard retain a native bridge that can request OS notification permission and send a test notification after its authorization-state semantics are corrected?
rationale: This is an intentional host-to-webview security boundary and user-facing capability addition; code review alone cannot determine the desired permanent trust and product contract.

options.title: Repair and approve the bridge
options.body: Make provisional authorization deliverable or represent it accurately, add real macOS proof, and approve the documented trusted-dashboard bridge contract.

options.title: Narrow the bridge
options.body: Keep permission-state display but remove or redesign OS-affecting actions if maintainers do not want dashboard content to initiate them.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve the bridge
recommendation.body: Make provisional authorization deliverable or represent it accurately, add real macOS proof, and approve the documented trusted-dashboard bridge contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history ties this contributor directly to the macOS dashboard bridge and its UI integration.
